home.title: UpdateOtter: Roblox Game Calculators, Wikis & Updates
home.description: Unofficial, fan-made calculators and wikis for Roblox games. Every value shows where it comes from and when we last checked it.

steal-an-egg.title: Steal an Egg Wiki: Pets, Eggs, Mutations & Biomes | UpdateOtter
steal-an-egg.description: Fan-made Steal an Egg wiki: every pet, egg, mutation and biome, with the source and last-checked date shown on each value.

steal-an-egg/calculator.description: Work out a Steal an Egg pet's income per second from its base income, mutation and weight. Free, no sign-up, works on phones.

steal-an-egg/eggs.description: Every egg in Steal an Egg with its cost, hatch time, zone and the pets it can hatch. Each value shows its source.

steal-an-egg/pets.title: Steal an Egg Pets List: Every Pet by Rarity | UpdateOtter
steal-an-egg/pets.description: All Steal an Egg pets sorted by rarity, with base income, the eggs they hatch from and the date each value was checked.

steal-an-egg/mutations.title: Steal an Egg Mutations & Size Multipliers | UpdateOtter
steal-an-egg/mutations.description: Every Steal an Egg mutation with its income multiplier, how weight changes income, and how the two stack, with a worked example.

steal-an-egg/tier-list.title: Steal an Egg Tier List: Best Pets Ranked | UpdateOtter

steal-an-egg/updates.title: Steal an Egg Updates: Weekly Patch Notes & Changes | UpdateOtter
steal-an-egg/updates.description: Steal an Egg updates we have tracked, newest first, and what changed in our data after each one.

grow-a-garden.title: Grow a Garden Wiki: Crops, Mutations & Codes | UpdateOtter
grow-a-garden.description: Fan-made Grow a Garden wiki: every crop with its base value and weight, all crop mutations, a sell-value calculator and the codes list.

grow-a-garden/calculator.title: Grow a Garden Calculator: Crop Value with Mutations | UpdateOtter
grow-a-garden/calculator.description: Work out what a Grow a Garden fruit sells for from its crop, weight, variant and up to three mutations. Free, no sign-up, works on phones.

grow-a-garden/plants.title: Grow a Garden Crops List: Values & Weights | UpdateOtter
grow-a-garden/plants.description: Every Grow a Garden crop by rarity with its base sell value, base weight and harvest type. Filter by rarity or sort by value.

grow-a-garden/codes.title: Grow a Garden Codes ({month}): Active & Expired | UpdateOtter

grow-a-garden-2/calculator.title: Grow a Garden 2 Calculator: Crop Value & Mutations | UpdateOtter
grow-a-garden-2/calculator.description: Work out what a fresh Grow a Garden 2 fruit sells for from its crop, weight and mutation. Free, no sign-up, works on phones.

grow-a-garden-2/plants.title: Grow a Garden 2 Crops List: Values, Weights & Tiers | UpdateOtter
grow-a-garden-2/plants.description: Every Grow a Garden 2 crop by tier with its base sell value, base weight, sell currency and harvest type.

grow-a-garden-2/mutations.title: Grow a Garden 2 Mutations: Multipliers & Sources | UpdateOtter

grow-a-garden-2/codes.title: Grow a Garden 2 Codes ({month}) & Rewards | UpdateOtter
